items.title: Zeer zeldzame Feyenoord-comeback in Sittard
items.summary: De overwinning van Feyenoord bij Fortuna Sittard was niet alleen extreem belangrijk voor de Rotterdamse ploeg, maar kende ook een historisch tintje.

items.title: Sir Alex Ferguson taken to hospital before Manchester United v Liverpool game
items.summary: Former United manager felt unwell at Old Trafford 84-year-old initially treated as precautionary measure Sir Alex Ferguson was reportedly taken to hospital from Old Trafford after feeling unwell before Manchester United’s hosting of Liverpool in the Premier League on Sunday afternoon. The move is thought to be a precautionary rather than an emergency measure regarding the 84-year-old former United manager who won 13 Premier League titles and the Champions League twice in his 27-year tenure at Old Trafford. Ferguson is a regular at United’s home games and has a row of seats in the Old Trafford directors’ box. Continue reading...

items.title: Howe set to stay in charge of Newcastle after summit
items.summary: Head coach Eddie Howe looks set to lead Newcastle into next season after talks with the club's Saudi Arabian leadership.

items.title: Van Persie is enorm opgelucht: 'Onmogelijk om hier lekker te spelen'
items.summary: De vreugde is groot bij Robin van Persie na de benauwde zege van Feyenoord op Fortuna Sittard. Feyenoord profiteerde dankzij de late goal van Givairo Read van het puntenverlies van onder meer NEC. Robin van Persie benadrukte ondanks de euforie dat de buit nog niet binnen is.

items.title: RKC Waalwijk haalt De Wijs terug naar Nederland
items.summary: RKC Waalwijk staat op het punt Jordy de Wijs terug naar Nederland te halen. De 31-jarige verdediger komt transfervrij over van Fortuna Düsseldorf en zal naar verwachting volgende week voor twee jaar tekenen.

items.title: The battle for sixth... and why teams might need to lose on final day
items.summary: As the Premier League's battle for European places hots up, BBC Sport assesses the situation - and some very strange potential quirks in the race.

items.title: Ferguson (84) uit voorzorg naar ziekenhuis vlak voor aftrap United - Liverpool
items.summary: Sir Alex Ferguson (84) is zondagmiddag uit voorzorg naar het ziekenhuis gebracht. De legendarische voormalig trainer van Manchester United was op Old Trafford aanwezig voor de kraker tegen Liverpool, maar verliet het stadion al voor de aftrap. Dat melden alle toonaangevende media in Engeland, waaronder de BBC.

items.title: Bournemouth beat Crystal Palace with ease to keep Champions League dreams alive
items.summary: By month’s end, Andoni Iraola and Oliver Glasner will depart their respective clubs. Having both taken their clubs into uncharted territory, neither’s task is yet complete. Bournemouth’s victory, a game all but won in the first half, was one for the club with their Premier League position as the priority. Bournemouth’s hopes of emulating Palace this season in playing European football for the first time were increased by a deserved, convincing win. The Champions League may even be in reach, Europa League permutations permitting. Palace played as if something else was on their minds. Perhaps understandably so. On Thursday, in the Conference League semi-final, Selhurst Park will stage the biggest match in 102 years of being home to south London’s Eagles. Continue reading...

items.title: Ferguson taken to hospital as precaution before Man Utd v Liverpool
items.summary: Sir Alex Ferguson is taken to hospital after falling unwell at Old Trafford shortly before Manchester United's Premier League match with Liverpool on Sunday.

items.title: Kerr breaks Kirby's Chelsea goal record
items.summary: Sam Kerr's headed goal gives Chelsea the lead at Leicester, to become the clubs all-time WSL top scorer with 64 goals overtaking Fran Kirby.

items.title: Manchester City on verge of WSL title after Knaak’s last-gasp winner sinks Liverpool
items.summary: Manchester City’s Rebecca Knaak scored a stoppage-time winner to give her side a nervy 1-0 home victory over Liverpool and put one hand on the Women’s Super League trophy. City top the standings on 52 points with one game left and are out of reach of second-placed Chelsea, who are nine points behind ahead of their clash with the bottom side, Leicester, later on Sunday. Continue reading...

items.title: Celtic level with Hearts at the top after Iheanacho winner breaks 10-man Hibs
items.summary: The substitute Kelechi Iheanacho kept his cool amid the tension as Celtic capitalised on more indiscipline from 10-man Hibernian to move level on points with the leaders, Hearts. Hibs’ cause was dented in the 20th minute when Jamie McGrath became their fourth player in three games to be sent off. Continue reading...
